data.title: bStocks by Binance hit $500M AUM, providing round-the-clock equity trading and access to U.S. stocks.
data.description: The tokenized securities platform of Binance, known as bStocks, has surpassed $500 million in assets under management (AUM). This platform allows for round-the-clock trading and provides access to U.S. equities outside of traditional Wall Street trading hours.

data.title: Amwell makes grant to new employees under inducement plan
data.description: Boston, August 7, 2026 - Amwell ®  (NYSE: AMWL), a top provider of SaaS-based software for tech-driven healthcare, disclosed that on August 7, it granted RSUs for a total of 6,679 shares of its Class A common stock to two new non-executive employees. The grants served as a significant incentive for the employees to join Amwell. If the employees remain with the company until the vesting date, 25% of the RSUs will vest on the first anniversary of the grant date, with the remaining 75% vesting in equal quarterly installments thereafter. Full vesting of the RSUs will occur on the first day of the month following the 48-month anniversary of the grant date.

data.title: BEP-675 improves BSC Testnet, raising throughput 88% to 2,324 TPS by streamlining block execution. Mainnet launch upcoming.
data.description: The performance of BEP-675 on BNB Chain testnet has significantly improved, registering an 88% increase in throughput to reach 2,324 transactions per second (TPS). This enhancement was achieved through optimizing block execution. The rollout of the updated BEP-675 on the mainnet is currently pending. For more details on this development, please refer to the full article.

data.title: HEI Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
data.description: Hawaiian Electric Industries, Inc. (NYSE: HEI) announced its second-quarter 2026 financial results with a reported net income of $123 million, equivalent to $0.71 per share. This shows a significant increase from the second quarter of 2025, where net income was $26 million, or $0.15 per share. The recent quarter's results were influenced by remeasuring the remaining Maui wildfire settlement liability to present value post the settlement agreement's confirmation in April. This process led to the fixing of the remaining payment obligations.

data.title: Sila Receives Conditional $1.4 Billion Loan Commitment from U.S. Department of War to Accelerate Domestic Battery Technology Manufacturing
data.description: Alameda-based Sila, a company specializing in advanced battery technology, revealed today it secured a conditional loan commitment totaling $1.4 billion from the United States Department of War via its Office of Strategic Capital (OSC). The funding is earmarked for bolstering the production capacity of Sila's silicon-carbon (Si/C) anode in its Moses Lake, Washington plant and constructing a lithium-ion battery cell manufacturing facility. The OSC's conditional support will enable the company to expand its operations significantly.

data.title: Senvest Capital Inc. Reports Results for the Second Quarter Ended June 30, 2026
data.description: On August 7, 2026, in Montreal, Senvest Capital Inc. announced a significant increase in net income attributable to common shareholders for the second quarter of 2026. data.title: aTyr Pharma Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results, Program Prioritization and Corporate Restructuring to Support Efzofitimod Program in ILD
data.description: aTyr Pharma recently revealed their financial results for the second quarter of 2026. The company disclosed plans to prioritize their Efzofitimod program for Interstitial Lung Disease (ILD), alongside a corporate restructuring effort. This decision aims to allocate resources effectively towards the Efzofitimod program. The restructuring will involve workforce adjustments, budget reallocations, and strategic initiatives to drive the ILD program forward. The company aims to enhance efficiency and streamline operations to focus on the development of Efzofitimod for ILD.
